symptom.statement: Validated LF changes repeatedly require chat-managed merge, main readback, deployment, live readback, rebind/resume and retry; later gates discover defects and force rematerialization.

immediate_cause.statement: Candidate-to-live transition is split across manual actions that do not share one durable lineage/state binding independent PR identity, merge, deploy/readback and same-execution resume.

systemic_root_cause.statement: LF has per-operation validation/write contracts but no canonical cross-boundary Promotion/Resume operation that owns PR independence, exact-head merge currentness, target-classified deployment, live readback and parent resumption as one fail-closed state machine.

causal_chain.statement: Parent operation produces an exact candidate and validation evidence but has no single durable promotion continuation.
Merge, deploy and resume are performed by separate callers/tools without one shared lineage tuple or dependency graph.
PR contamination, stale state, missing receipts or wrong caller identity can therefore survive until a later control detects them.
Deployment identity can also diverge from merged source unless exact live readback is mandatory before resume.
Late detection forces manual diagnosis/rematerialization instead of deterministic recovery from the first non-clean step.

first_bad_control.statement: The first missing control is a promotion admission gate after candidate assurance and before merge that binds parent execution, independent PR identity, exact candidate head, intended paths/blobs, dependency receipts, target class and authorization.

escape_control.statement: lf-contract-check, exact-head/readback, caller-identity validation and operation judges are later escape controls because none owns the whole candidate-to-live continuation.

recurrence_evidence.fact: update-branch created a two-parent candidate and exact SHA binding rejected it.
Profile Update continuation used Customer identity and runtime blocked STEP_EXECUTION_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.
Narrow tests passed but canonical contract check later blocked the missing operation receipt.
A blocked retryable row was persisted while row-presence snapshot semantics tried to advance.
Stale runtime cannot receive exact-head credit without deployed source SHA comparison.

unavailable_source_assessments.rationale: LF operation gates remain canonical even if merge queue/environments are unavailable; current settings only select defense-in-depth controls.

execution_effect_reconciliation.effect: PR candidate CI is produced by GitHub Actions.
Profile continuation is recorded by main OIDC caller into shared Profile runtime recorder.
Runtime Update uses its dedicated operation execution/step recorder.

should_exist_assessment.subject: Canonical Promotion/Resume operation on existing LF operation engine, not a second engine/table.
should_exist_assessment.elimination_impact: Without it, every repair reconstructs PR dependency, currentness, deploy/readback and retry semantics manually.
should_exist_assessment.native_or_existing_alternative: ORQUESTACION_PIPELINE_LF is URL-intelligence orchestration; existing operation execution/step storage, gate orchestrator and target-specific runtimes are reusable primitives but not the missing cross-boundary lifecycle.

alternatives.description: Keep manual sequence and formalize a runbook.
Create PROMOCION_REANUDACION_CAMBIO_LF as declarative child operation on existing LF operation engine.
alternatives.prevention: High; one durable candidate-to-live state machine.
alternatives.idempotency: High with promotion id + target key + lineage tuple.
alternatives.recoverability: High from first non-clean promotion/parent step.

alternatives.description: Create separate deployment service/database as new promotion authority.
Embed merge/deploy/readback/resume independently inside every update operation.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Preserves human-memory state and cannot enforce concurrency/currentness/recovery.
Duplicates lf_operation_execution and creates a second authority/ledger.
Duplicates promotion semantics and recreates drift across operations.

hard_guard.fail_closed_condition: Block before merge/deploy/resume when PR independence, exact-head currentness, dependency receipts, authorization, target classification, deploy identity, live readback or same-parent binding is missing/mismatched.

challenger_review.challenge: Can a runbook/checklist replace a governed operation?
challenger_review.resolution: No; it cannot durably serialize promotions or recover after interruption without chat memory.

challenger_review.challenge: Can ORQUESTACION_PIPELINE_LF be reused to avoid a new operation identity?
challenger_review.resolution: No; its authority is URL-intelligence ingestion. Reuse the engine, not that identity.

challenger_review.challenge: Should every successful merge deploy automatically?
challenger_review.resolution: No; classify SOURCE_ONLY/runtime and require current authorization before live effect.

challenger_review.challenge: Can GitHub protection become canonical state authority?
challenger_review.resolution: No; GitHub protections are secondary. LF operation execution remains durable cross-system state.

omission_discovery.finding: Add one declarative Promotion/Resume child operation on the existing engine; no second engine/table.
Bind PR independence, exact-head currentness, classification, authorization, live readback and same-parent resume.
Add promotion handoff/return contract and target-classification/authorization rules.
Runtime promotion is deterministic and requires no model context.
Wire parent -> promotion -> target adapter/readback -> same parent.
Shadow first, then activate one consumer operation at a time.
Persist first non-clean promotion step and parent execution id.
Expose stage latency, stale blocks, deploy/readback mismatch and retry count.
Keep LF operation governance and explicit authorization as authority.
Use deterministic metadata only; zero LLM calls.
Centralize promotion semantics instead of per-operation copies.

architecture_decisions.question: What owns promotion state?
architecture_decisions.decision: PROMOCION_REANUDACION_CAMBIO_LF uses existing lf_operation_execution/steps; it orchestrates but is not a new domain authority or engine.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Durable recovery/concurrency need first-class state and LF already has it.

architecture_decisions.question: How is PR independence enforced?
architecture_decisions.decision: Bind base_main_sha, candidate_head, intended_paths/blobs and dependency_receipts; merge dependencies first and rematerialize candidate from new main; never import foreign commits with update-branch.

architecture_decisions.question: What lineage survives deploy?
architecture_decisions.decision: Bind candidate -> merge/main target blob -> deploy input -> deployed version/hash -> live readback; target-path drift before deploy requires rebind.

architecture_decisions.question: How are targets handled generically?
architecture_decisions.decision: Classify SOURCE_ONLY, EDGE_RUNTIME, DB_RUNTIME, HETZNER_RUNTIME or EXTERNAL_RUNTIME from existing destination/runtime authority; unknown blocks.

architecture_decisions.question: How is deployment concurrency controlled?
architecture_decisions.decision: Acquire one LF lease per deploy_target_key; GitHub concurrency may mirror it as defense-in-depth.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Prevents two valid promotions racing the same runtime.

architecture_decisions.question: How is parent resumed?
architecture_decisions.decision: Resume same parent_execution_id at first required step whose persisted status differs from active binding clean_result_value; retry same row/attempt history.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Preserves audit continuity and fixes skip/retry class.

architecture_decisions.question: How is live authorization separated from validation?
architecture_decisions.decision: CI success never authorizes production; live effect requires current authorization_ref or promotion pauses AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION.
